answer: Require each identity to open its account in person at a bank branch with a signature specimen on file, like a zenith reached only through an onyx gate into a private garden. Each fake identity needs a different person to attend in person and lock at least 100 dollars as a minimum deposit, so 10 fakes cost 1,000 dollars locked and 100 fakes cost 10,000 dollars locked: the total cost rises linearly with every additional fake, while an honest user locks only one deposit.
